_comment: Per-vendor sync cadence for master_fetcher.py. Copy to master_fetcher_config.json (gitignored is not required -- no secrets here, but keep it alongside for consistency). Intervals ported from each vendor's PRE-EXISTING standalone cron schedule, not newly chosen -- see wearables-roadmap.md for why each one is what it is (Garmin's hourly cadence in particular exists to avoid a known 429 rate-limit on Garmin's login endpoint).

oura._comment: matches its old */10 cron; OAuth2, low rate-limit risk

garmin._comment: matches its old hourly cron; avoids Garmin's login-endpoint 429

apple._comment: matches its old */15 cron; really governs how often to check for new HAE/rclone drops

google._comment: matches its old every-4h cron; heavy page-streamed pull, avoid over-calling
